nodes.label: ADR-005: Strict-priority tiered parallel scheduling
nodes.rationale: FIFO queue plus a concurrency cap lets low-priority tasks fill all slots and starve high-priority ones; strict priority tiers guarantee a bounded wait for high priority at the accepted cost of idle parallelism when a high tier has few tasks.

nodes.label: Strict priority tier with in-tier FCFS
nodes.rationale: Priority is read from STATE.md at enqueue time (default 5); only one priority tier runs at any moment, higher tiers are never preempted but start as soon as the current tier drains, and verifier-after-implementer ordering is preserved by in-tier FCFS.

nodes.label: agents.max_concurrent reuse
nodes.rationale: Parallelism within a tier reuses the existing agents.max_concurrent key; no new configuration option is introduced, so single-priority SPECs degenerate to the old FIFO+cap behavior.
